definitions.explanation: A word or phrase that has been shortened from its full form, including both truncated words and terms formed from initial letters.

examples.english: What is that an abbreviation for?

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{略語|りゃくご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many abbreviations from English in Japanese too.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{略語|りゃくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}→正式名称：23603_seishikimeishou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: In this document, when using abbreviations, please write out the full name first.

notes:
Refers to a word or phrase that has been shortened from its full form. Combines ⟦{略|りゃく}→略：21443_ryaku⟧ (abbreviation, omission) and ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (word, language).

USAGE:
- Used for both abbreviations (shortened words) and acronyms (words formed from initials)
- Japanese has many abbreviations formed by taking the first two mora of compound words (e.g., ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧ from ⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧)
- English-origin acronyms are also common in Japanese (e.g., SNS, IT, AI)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {略語|りゃくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use an abbreviation
- {略語|りゃくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧: the meaning of an abbreviation
- {略語|りゃくご}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say in abbreviated form
- {略語|りゃくご}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of abbreviations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{省略|しょうりゃく}→省略：03244_shouryaku⟧: omission, abbreviation — the act of shortening, broader in scope
- {頭文字|かしらもじ}: initials, acronym — specifically refers to initial letters
- ⟦{短縮形|たんしゅくけい}→短縮形：23422_tanshukukei⟧: shortened form — a more technical/linguistic term
